nodes.label: §0.1 No backend
nodes.rationale: All data lives in chrome.storage.local and nothing leaves the browser; this is what makes the project legal, private, free to run and buildable in weeks. It also rules out subscribable .ics feeds, SMS/email reminders and cross-device sync.

nodes.label: §0.2 No credential handling
nodes.rationale: The extension never sees a password; it fetches with the session cookies already in the browser. An expired session is reported as needs_login with a link to the login page — it never tries to log in.

nodes.label: §0.3 Parsers fail loudly
nodes.rationale: A page that should contain assignments but yields zero rows is a parse error, not an empty result. Silent emptiness is the worst failure mode because the student trusts a list that is missing things.

nodes.label: §0.4 Declarative adapters only
nodes.rationale: Course-site adapters are JSON (URLs + CSS selectors + date formats), never code. Manifest V3 forbids remotely loaded code; remote data is fine, so selectors can be fixed without a store re-review.

nodes.label: §0.5 Chrome only
nodes.rationale: Firefox later; MV3 differences (no offscreen API in Firefox). The parser layer is written so it can move, nothing else is abstracted.

nodes.label: §0.6 Ship ugly
nodes.rationale: The popup is a list; design polish is v1.1.

nodes.label: Out of scope for v1
nodes.rationale: Campuswire and LLM announcement parsing need a backend and cost money; Google Calendar OAuth needs sensitive-scope verification (ship sync in v1.1); a subscribable .ics feed and SMS/email need a server; Moodle only if beta testers hit it; Firefox lacks offscreen.

nodes.label: Service worker architecture (§2)
nodes.rationale: chrome.alarms every 30 min runs runSync: fetch → parse (via offscreen) → normalize → dedupe with overrides → store → notifications; registry refreshed daily.

nodes.label: Offscreen document (DOM_PARSER)
nodes.rationale: MV3 service workers have no DOMParser. Regex is fragile and a bundled HTML parser adds 100KB+, so chrome.offscreen with reason DOM_PARSER is used. DOMParser documents are inert (no script execution, no resource loading), which is the security property wanted when parsing untrusted HTML.

nodes.label: Pure parser contract (doc, ctx) => RawItem[]
nodes.rationale: Parsers are pure functions over a Document so they run unchanged in Node tests (linkedom) and in the offscreen document.

nodes.label: Cookie-authenticated fetch (Gate 0 assumption)
nodes.rationale: Requests from extension contexts to host_permissions hosts carry the user's cookies with credentials: include and are exempt from SameSite. The whole project rests on this.

nodes.label: Content-script fetch fallback
nodes.rationale: If a host fails Gate 0 (or Cloudflare blocks extension requests, or a site is client-rendered), inject a content script and fetch from page context; uglier because it needs a tab, so only if needed. Not needed after G0 passed 4/4.

nodes.label: Permissions model (§2.3)
nodes.rationale: Fixed host_permissions for the hosted sources and raw.githubusercontent.com; course sites use optional_host_permissions requested on enable so the listing does not look greedy. Never <all_urls>, tabs or webRequest — faster store review and a one-sentence privacy story.

nodes.label: Build toolchain (§2.4)
nodes.rationale: TypeScript + esbuild, vitest + linkedom for parser tests, near-zero runtime dependencies, vanilla DOM popup.

nodes.label: RawItem
nodes.rationale: One row as one source sees it; immutable once parsed. url must be absolute https on the source host; dueAt is ISO 8601 with offset.

nodes.label: Item
nodes.rationale: One deadline as the student sees it: one or more RawItems merged. id is sha1 of sorted member keys so an unchanged group keeps its notified record across syncs.

nodes.label: SourceStatus
nodes.rationale: Per-source health: state ok / needs_login / parse_error / network_error / disabled, lastAttemptAt, lastSuccessAt, lastError, consecutiveFailures.

nodes.label: Overrides
nodes.rationale: User corrections: mergeGroups, splitKeys, hiddenItemIds, disabledCourses — keyed by memberKey so they survive re-scrapes.

nodes.label: StoreV1
nodes.rationale: schemaVersion 1; raw keyed by memberKey, items, sources, overrides, settings, registry.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.rationale: leadTimes (24h/2h), quietHours (default 23–8), hideSubmitted (default true), pollMinutes (default 30, min 15).

nodes.label: Adapter (declarative course-site adapter)
nodes.rationale: id, label, courseCode, term (adapters expire), one fixed url, hostPattern for the optional permission, row/title/due/link selectors, dateFormat, timezone, filter regexes, minExtensionVersion. No expression language, no JS, no eval.

nodes.label: SourceModule contract (§4)
nodes.rationale: plan(ctx) → FetchPlan, parse(doc, page) → RawItem[] which throws ParseError on structural surprise and never returns [] for a page whose structure says items exist, isLoginPage(resp, body).

nodes.label: memberKey = source:sourceId
nodes.rationale: Must be stable across re-scrapes or every override breaks on the next sync.

nodes.label: sourceId rules per source (§3.1)
nodes.rationale: Canvas plannable_type:plannable_id; Gradescope assignment id or hash(courseId+normalizedTitle); PrairieLearn assessment id; PrairieTest exam id and examId:booking; Site adapterId:hash(normalizedTitle+dueDate) — course sites have no ids, so a rename mints a new key and a hide or merge is lost (accepted).

nodes.label: Timezone handling (§3.2)
nodes.rationale: Store every instant as ISO 8601 with offset, never naive local time; display in the browser's zone. Per-source formats confirmed: Canvas ISO UTC, Gradescope 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS -0500', PrairieLearn no year/no zone, PrairieTest CDT/CST abbreviations. DST 2026-11-01 only matters inside the offset computation.

nodes.label: parseLocalDate(parts, zone) helper
nodes.rationale: Build the instant from wall-clock parts in a named zone with an Intl.DateTimeFormat offset lookup — no library for one zone; must compute the offset for the specific date, not a fixed -05:00.

nodes.label: Year inference with weekday check
nodes.rationale: Assume the current year; if more than 6 months in the past add one; if a weekday is present and does not match, try adjacent years and pick the one that matches.

nodes.label: Fetch rules for all sources
nodes.rationale: credentials include, redirect follow, check resp.url for login/SSO hosts; 20 s timeout; ≤4 concurrent per host; per-source backoff; browser User-Agent; roughly 1 + #courses requests per HTML source per sync.

nodes.label: Per-source backoff
nodes.rationale: 30 min → 1 h → 2 h → 4 h cap on failure; reset on success. Non-manual triggers skip a source in backoff.

nodes.label: needs_login detection
nodes.rationale: A response landing on shibboleth, login.illinois.edu or /login is needs_login, reported with a button that opens the source's login page — never parse_error.

nodes.label: Canvas source (§4.1, REST API)
nodes.rationale: Uses the real REST API with session cookies: courses (to filter concluded ones) and planner items. Undated assignments are ignored in v1. LTI-linked Gradescope assignments appear here too — the main dedupe case. Every source stays enabled because instructors set dates inconsistently; the union is what is correct.

nodes.label: Canvas planner items endpoint
nodes.rationale: /api/v1/planner/items over now-7d..now+60d; Link-header pagination; submissions object gives submitted/graded/missing/late/excused.

nodes.label: Canvas while(1); prefix
nodes.rationale: JSON-hijacking protection prepended to bodies fetched with a browser session; detect it rather than blindly slicing 9 characters, in case it is absent for token users.

nodes.label: Canvas plannable_type → Kind mapping
nodes.rationale: quiz→quiz; assignment→assignment; calendar_event with exam|midterm|final→exam else other; discussion_topic→assignment; planner_note/announcement/wiki_page skipped.

nodes.label: Gradescope source (§4.2, HTML)
nodes.rationale: Two-stage plan: dashboard (first term group in DOM order) then each course page. No API; ToS discourages automation, so make about the same requests a student's browser would at ≥15 min intervals. Expired sessions redirect to /login.

nodes.label: Gradescope row structure and parser rules
nodes.rationale: Rows are tr with th.table--primaryLink; status from td.submissionStatus text (ignore modifier classes); due = first time.submissionTimeChart--dueDate whose aria-label starts 'Due', late = 'Late Due Date'; header-based column detection kept as fallback; no table at all is a ParseError, zero rows is a legitimate empty course.

nodes.label: Gradescope datetime attribute format
nodes.rationale: '2026-09-09 17:00:00 -0500' — not ISO (space separator, offset without colon); parse explicitly, never rely on new Date().

nodes.label: PrairieLearn source (§4.3, HTML)
nodes.rationale: Student home lists course instances; each assessments page has badge, name, available credit and score columns. Badge encodes type (HW3, L4a, PQ1) and takes part in title normalization. Score maps to status; NOT FOR CREDIT titles get extra.forCredit=false but are kept.

nodes.label: PrairieLearn access-details credit schedule
nodes.rationale: The ? popover table (Credit, Start, End) is the best-structured deadline data in the project, so it is the primary source: dueAt = end of the highest-credit row, lateDueAt = end of the next credit drop (not the semester-long tail); stored as extra.creditSchedule. Cross-checked against the cell's current tier.

nodes.label: PrairieLearn credit cell text (fallback)
nodes.rationale: '80% until 23:59, Tue, Sep 8' shows only the tier available now. 100% → dueAt; <100% → the full-credit deadline has passed, lateDueAt = that instant. A non-matching cell is a per-row error, and the row is still emitted undated.

nodes.label: PrairieTest source (§4.4, HTML)
nodes.rationale: The headline feature: the /pt/ home has an 'Exam reservations' card and an 'Exams available for reservations' card; produces two RawItems per exam.

nodes.label: PrairieTest reservations card
nodes.rationale: One entry per booked exam: link with exam id, CBTF location, session instant 'Thu, Sep 10, 1pm (CDT)', duration/format/accommodations line. kind exam, status unknown.

nodes.label: PrairieTest available-for-reservation card
nodes.rationale: One row per exam with an open reservation window; the right column is the session window (dates only), not a booking deadline. unbooked = present here AND absent from the reservations card.

nodes.label: PrairieTest booking pseudo-item
nodes.rationale: 'Book a slot: {exam}', kind booking, dueAt = windowStart deliberately early because slots fill; extra.deadlineIsEstimate and wording 'sessions Sep 8–10, not booked', never 'due'. Disappears once the exam is booked; a missed window shows 3 days then purges.

nodes.label: Course-site adapters and runner (§4.5)
nodes.rationale: Generic runner over a JSON registry: fetch url, DOMParser, apply selectors, parse with the declared date format, emit source 'site'. Zero rows on a fetched page is a ParseError for that adapter only. JS-rendered sites are unsupported in v1.

nodes.label: Adapter registry (bundled + daily GitHub refresh)
nodes.rationale: adapters/registry.json is bundled; once a day the worker fetches the same file from raw.githubusercontent.com, validates it, and replaces the stored copy; a bad remote file is rejected. Lets a broken selector be fixed without a store re-review.

nodes.label: Course code extraction (§5.1)
nodes.rationale: Regex ([A-Z]{2,4})\s*-?\s*(\d{3}[A-Z]?) on the raw course string; first match is courseCode, cross-listings stash altCodes; no match falls back to the first 12 characters of courseRaw.

nodes.label: Title normalization (§5.2)
nodes.rationale: Comparison only, display never altered: lowercase, strip punctuation, synonyms (homework→hw, machine problem→mp), join prefix+number (hw 02→hw2), drop filler tokens, result is a token set.

nodes.label: Auto-merge rule (§5.3)
nodes.rationale: Merge two RawItems when same course, both dated within 24 h or both undated, Jaccard ≥ 0.6 or a ≥2-token subset, and different sources. False merges are visible (two source icons) and fixed by one-click split; G3 measures how often.

nodes.label: Transitive union-find merge with overrides
nodes.rationale: Union-find over all raw items; splitKeys become singletons, mergeGroups are unioned in; Item.id = sha1 of sorted member keys.

nodes.label: Canonical field precedence for merged items
nodes.rationale: url and dueAt: Gradescope > PrairieLearn > PrairieTest > site > Canvas, because the submission system is the source of truth for its own deadline and Canvas LTI dates are copies. title = longest member title; courseLabel = Canvas course_code else shortest courseRaw.

nodes.label: Status = most done of the members
nodes.rationale: graded > submitted > not_submitted > missing > unknown: if Gradescope says submitted and Canvas has not synced yet, the student did submit.

nodes.label: Retention and purge (§5.4)
nodes.rationale: Purge raw items due more than 60 days ago and undated items not seen in the last 3 syncs; overrides referencing purged keys are dropped.

nodes.label: Sync loop runSync (§6)
nodes.rationale: For each enabled source not in backoff: plan → fetchAll → login check → parseAll via offscreen → replace that source's raw items atomically → mark ok; ParseError → parse_error + backoff, NetworkError → network_error + backoff. Then dedupe, store items, schedule notifications. A failing source never blocks the others.

nodes.label: Popup-triggered sync debounce
nodes.rationale: runSync('popup') on open, skipped if lastSyncAt is within 5 minutes.

nodes.label: Notifications (§7)
nodes.rationale: For dated, unhidden, unfinished, non-booking items fire at dueAt−24h and dueAt−2h once each via chrome.alarms named notify:{itemId}:{lead}; clicking opens item.url; stale alarms after the deadline are skipped and marked missed.

nodes.label: Quiet hours
nodes.rationale: Default 23:00–08:00; notifications inside the window defer to its end. A 2 h lead for 11:59 PM fires at 9:59 PM, so the common case is unaffected.

nodes.label: Daily booking nag
nodes.rationale: One notification per day at 10:00 local for booking items until the exam is booked, recorded as notified.booking.

nodes.label: Popup UI (§8.1)
nodes.rationale: Single scrolling list, width 400px, max height 600px; header with per-source health, sync-now and open-full-view; footer with Download .ics and settings.

nodes.label: Popup sections
nodes.rationale: Needs attention (bookings, overdue ≤7 days), Today, Tomorrow, This week, Later (60 days); empty sections hidden.

nodes.label: Row menu (⋯)
nodes.rationale: Hide, Split (if merged), Merge with… (same-course picker), Add to Google Calendar.

nodes.label: Per-source health indicator
nodes.rationale: Green ok / yellow needs login / red error with lastSuccessAt and lastError tooltip; a yellow dot opens the login page. Later replaced by one health pill (PROGRESS phase C).

nodes.label: Rendering security rules
nodes.rationale: All source text inserted with textContent, never innerHTML; URLs rendered only if https on a known host or the adapter's host.

nodes.label: Options page (§8.2)
nodes.rationale: Sources enable/disable with status and login links; per-course checkboxes; adapters filtered to the current term with permission-requesting toggles; reminders; data export/reset; plain-language privacy note.

nodes.label: Report a broken page flow
nodes.rationale: User pastes a URL; the extension fetches it, scrubs PII (emails, the student's name), and offers a download to attach to a GitHub issue. Nothing is sent automatically.

nodes.label: Calendar export (§8.3)
nodes.rationale: Per item a Google Calendar template link (15-minute event ending at dueAt, no OAuth); bulk .ics download of visible items, described as a one-time copy, not a subscription.

nodes.label: Gate G0 — Auth fetch
nodes.rationale: From the service worker, the authenticated home page of all four hosted sources returns logged-in content with credentials: include. PASSED 2026-09-03, 4/4.

nodes.label: Gate G1 — Fixtures + parsers
nodes.rationale: Scrubbed fixtures for every page type; parser tests pass with hand-written expected outputs; a fixture with the table removed makes the parser throw.

nodes.label: Gate G2 — Recall
nodes.rationale: End-to-end sync on the author's account lists every deadline visible on every source for 3 weeks (100% recall, no phantoms). PASSED on live data.

nodes.label: Gate G3 — Dedupe
nodes.rationale: Auto-merge produces the right groups with ≤2 manual corrections, else tune §5.3. Passed on n=1 merge; the threshold question stays open until G4.

nodes.label: Gate G4 — Beta
nodes.rationale: 10 users across ≥3 majors for a week; zero data-loss bugs, every parse error surfaced, ≥7 of 10 would keep it. Sushi's; cannot start from the agent side.

nodes.label: Gate G5 — Store
nodes.rationale: Privacy policy published, permission justifications, screenshots, submitted. Gated behind G4.

nodes.label: Build order (§10)
nodes.rationale: Scaffold → G0 spike → offscreen plumbing → fixture capture → Canvas → Gradescope/PrairieLearn/PrairieTest → normalize+dedupe → store+sync+popup (G2, G3) → notifications → options/overrides/.ics → adapters → report flow/policy/store (G4, G5).

nodes.label: Risk: silent missing deadline
nodes.rationale: Catastrophic if it happens; mitigated by §0 rule 3 (fail loudly), per-source health dots and the G2 recall test.

nodes.label: Open questions (§12)
nodes.rationale: Resolved: hostnames, page-context cookie fetch, Gradescope term order and row DOM, PrairieLearn layout and popover, PrairieTest cards. Still open at spec time: popover in fetched HTML, available-row link, extension-context G0, other PL credit shapes, Moodle/client-rendered sites.

nodes.label: Fixture scrubbing (Appendix A)
nodes.rationale: Replace name, NetID, email, student IDs with STUDENT / netid / student@illinois.edu / 000000000; keep course and assignment names and dates real because parsers depend on them.

nodes.label: Privacy policy (Appendix B)
nodes.rationale: Runs entirely in the browser, never sees a password, stores locally, one daily request to GitHub for the adapter list, uninstall deletes everything. Later generated by scripts/site.mjs and published on GitHub Pages.

hyperedges.label: §0 decisions that are not up for debate in v1
Gates G0–G5, in order; do not proceed past a failed gate
